title: NPC Code
description: Autonomous coding agent monorepo: standalone terminal CLI (@npc/cli), VS Code extension, and core runtime engine with tool execution & model routing.

title: CADFusion
description: CAD workspace in the browser: sketching, solid modelling, scene tree and cloud sync, on OpenCascade compiled to WebAssembly, with a LangChain agent that drives deterministic CAD tools.
tech: Three.js + OpenCascade WASM + LangGraph + NVIDIA NIM

title: YUGHO
description: Live store for sweat-proof undershirts, shipping across India: catalog, checkout with PhonePe, orders, reviews, coupons, preorders and warehouse-aware shipping through NimbusPost, with tracking webhooks.

title: Ardor
description: PWA for making friends in real life: circles, hangouts with RSVP, group chat, party games and synced video. Runs on free tiers with no socket server: Web Push for events and WebRTC for live play. English and Hindi.

title: GourmetOS
description: Restaurant operating system: guests order from a QR code on the table, orders reach a live kitchen display, and payments settle by UPI with no commission. Multi-tenant, with idempotent mutations, a transactional outbox and an offline-safe PWA.

title: AiDocs
description: Desktop AI Document Intelligence & Retrieval application combining local embeddings, vector search, Socket.IO live progress updates, and local LLM-assisted analysis.

title: Code-DCR
description: PyTorch deep learning architecture and research implementation accompanying academic paper on code representation and structural modeling.

title: CFD-Toolkit
description: Computational Fluid Dynamics toolkit with helper functions to parse, slice, and view OpenFOAM simulation outputs in real-time in the browser.

title: RN SMS Fetch
description: High-performance native module for React Native Android New Architecture (TurboModule) published on NPM for background SMS analysis.
